description.zh:
模板执行后的回调。

> 注： 按需触发的模板不支持回调参数。
description.en:
Callback URL to be invoked after template execution.  

> Note: Templates triggered on demand do not support callback parameters.

description.zh: 模板描述。
description.en: Template description.

description.zh:
存储文件格式，多值用逗号分隔。取值：
- mp4
- flv
- hls
> 青岛单元暂不支持flv、mp4录制
description.en:
Storage file format. Multiple values are separated by commas. Valid values:
- mp4
- flv
- hls
> The Qingdao ingest endpoint does not support recording in FLV or MP4 formats.

description.zh: FLV的存储路径。格式参考Mp4说明。
description.en: Storage path for FLV files. For the format, see the description for Mp4.

description.zh: HLS的存储路径，m3u8文件。格式参考Mp4说明。
description.en: Storage path for HLS m3u8 files. For the format, see the description for Mp4.

Storage path for HLS .ts files.
- Variables can be used in the path. Supported variables include {AppName}, {StreamName}, {UnixTimestamp}, and {Sequence}.
- The variables {UnixTimestamp} and {Sequence} must both be included.

description.zh: 操作周期，单位秒。
description.en: Operation epoch, in seconds.

description.zh:
JPG的存储路径，用于按需截图。
- 目前仅支持生成jpg图片。
- 支持变量匹配，包含{AppName}、{StreamName}、{UnixTimestamp}、{Sequence}
- {UnixTimestamp}、{Sequence}必填一个
description.en:
Storage path for on-demand JPG screenshots.
- Only JPG images are currently supported.
- Variables can be used in the path. Supported variables include {AppName}, {StreamName}, {UnixTimestamp}, and {Sequence}.
- Either {UnixTimestamp} or {Sequence} must be included.

Storage path for JPG files used in overwrite snapshots.  
- Only JPG images are currently supported.  
- Supports variable substitution with {AppName} and {StreamName}.

description.zh:
JPG的存储路径，用于序列截图。
- 目前仅支持生成jpg图片。
- 支持变量匹配，包含{AppName}、{StreamName}、{UnixTimestamp}、{Sequence}
- {UnixTimestamp}、{Sequence}必填一个
description.en:
Storage path for JPG files used in sequential snapshots.  
- Only JPG images are currently supported.  
- Supports variable substitution with {AppName}, {StreamName}, {UnixTimestamp}, and {Sequence}.  
- Either {UnixTimestamp} or {Sequence} is required.

Storage path for MP4 files.  
- The path supports variable substitution. Available variables include {AppName}, {StreamName}, {Sequence}, {EscapedStartTime}, and {EscapedEndTime}.  
- {EscapedStartTime} and {EscapedEndTime} are required.

description.zh: 模板名称。
description.en: Template Name.

description.zh: OSS的Bucket。
description.en: OSS bucket.

description.zh: OSS的域名。
description.en: Domain name of OSS.

description.zh: OSS文件前缀
description.en: OSS file prefix.

description.zh: OSS所属区域，即服务中心。
description.en: Region where the OSS bucket resides, that is, the service center.

description.zh: 时移保存周期，单位：天
description.en: Time-shift retention period, in days.

description.zh: 转码配置TransConfig类型的数组，JSON格式字符串
description.en: An array of TransConfig-type transcoding configurations, formatted as a JSON string.

description.zh:
模板触发类型，默认auto。取值：
- auto（自动）
- ondemand（按需）
description.en:
Template trigger type. Default value: auto. Valid values:  
- auto (automatic)  
- ondemand (on-demand)

description.zh:
模板类型。取值：
- record（录制）
- snapshot（截图）
- transcode（转码）
- timeshift（时移）
description.en:
Template type. Valid values:  
- record (recording)  
- snapshot (snapshot)  
- transcode (transcoding)  
- timeshift (time shifting)
